AMIT KUMAR

Mobile: 8010513827 tools amitglobaledu.23@gmail.com

Sr. Business Analyst – Banking BFSI Domain Payments | Digital Banking | Cards| Retail Banking | Corporate Banking SDLC – Waterfall, Agile – Jira, Confluence

Career Objective Results-oriented Banking Business Analyst with extensive experience in the BFSI sector, seeking to leverage deep domain expertise in Payments, Digital Banking, Retail Banking, and Corporate Banking to deliver innovative business solutions. Passionate about bridging business needs with technology capabilities to drive process optimization, operational efficiency, digital transformation, automation, and enhanced customer experiences in an evolving financial ecosystem.

Professional Summary

Senior Business Analyst (Banking BFSI) with 15 years of experience in Banking & Financial Services and a

Certified Scrum Master (CSM).

7+ years of experience driving Agile delivery, digital transformation, and enterprise banking programs within

regulated BFSI environments.

Domain expertise in Payments, Digital Banking, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Cards,Digital Lending,

Insurance, and Customer Onboarding.

Strong understanding of Domestic and Cross-Border Payments, including payment processing, settlement,

reconciliation, and transaction lifecycle management.

Hands on experience of SWIFT MT and ISO 20022 (MX) messaging standards and payment modernization initiatives.

Familiar with payment schemes including UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS, SWIFT, SEPA & CHAPS. • Experienced in Requirements Gathering, Business Process Analysis, Stakeholder Management, Gap Analysis, and Solution Delivery.

Skilled in eliciting requirements through workshops, interviews, brainstorming sessions, surveys, shadowing,

JAD sessions, and document analysis.

Expertise in preparing BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Use Cases, Process Flows, and UML

Diagrams.

Proven experience conducting AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, process optimization, automation, and business

transformation initiatives.

Strong stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Business, Product,

Technology, QA, Vendors, and Leadership teams.

Hands-on experience in UAT support, requirements traceability, defect management, and production

readiness activities.

Extensive experience with Core Banking platforms including Finacle, Flexcube, CRM, Retail Banking, and

Corporate Banking applications.

Proficient in Agile/Scrum methodologies and tools including JIRA, Confluence, Visio, and MS Office Suite. • Strong expertise in Payments, BRD/FRD Development, User Stories, UAT, Agile Delivery, Process Re- engineering, and Banking Transformation Programs.

Core Competencies

Business Analysis & Delivery

Requirements Gathering & Elicitation

BRD, FRD & User Stories

Gap Analysis (AS-IS / TO-BE)

Business Process Modelling

Agile & Waterfall Methodologies

Professional Experience 1) MITS Global Consulting Pvt Ltd Client: CSB Bank, Mumbai Duration: June 2024 to June 2026.

Senior Business Analyst – Digital Banking, Payments & Corporate Lending Project: Digital Banking Transformation covering Customer Onboarding, Payments, CASA, Deposits, Corporate Lending, Account Servicing, KYC/AML Compliance, and Core Banking (Flexcube) integration across Net Banking and Mobile Banking platforms.

Roles & Responsibilities:

Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements through BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.

Led requirement analysis and solution design for Payments, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, CASA, Deposits, Account Servicing, and Corporate Lending journeys.

Worked on Domestic Payments (UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS), payment processing, reconciliation, transaction lifecycle management, and customer servicing workflows.

Supported Cross-Border Payments, SWIFT MT, and ISO 20022 readiness initiatives as part of payment modernization programs.

Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, Gap Analysis, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives. • Collaborated with Business, Operations, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Product, and Technology teams to deliver banking and payments solutions.

Supported Corporate Lending processes including customer onboarding, credit assessment, loan origination, disbursement, servicing, and collections journeys.

Facilitated stakeholder workshops, backlog refinement, requirement walkthroughs, and business sign-offs in Agile delivery environments.

Supported UAT planning, test case reviews, defect management, release validation, and production readiness activities.

Coordinated integrations across Flexcube, Payments, KYC/AML, CRM, APIs, and third-party banking systems.

2) Aarav Global Products & Services Pvt Ltd. Client: Bank of Baroda - Feb 2024 to June 2024.

Business Analyst – Cards & Payments | Credit Card Origination & Servicing

Roles & Responsibilities:

• Gathered and documented requirements for Co-Branded Credit Card Origination, Servicing, and Card Lifecycle

Management initiatives.

Prepared BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Flows, and API Integration documentation. • Collaborated with Business Teams, IT Vendors, and Technology teams to deliver Cards & Payments solutions. • Conducted Gap Analysis (AS-IS / TO-BE) and defined business requirements, scope, and acceptance criteria. • Facilitated requirement walkthroughs and coordinated with UI/UX, Development, and QA teams. • Supported UAT, test case reviews, defect resolution, and business sign-off activities. • Managed stakeholder communication and vendor coordination throughout the project lifecycle.

3) Axis Bank Ltd Duration: Apr 2019 to Feb 2024. Business Analyst – Digital Banking, Payments, Retail Banking & Corporate Lending Transformation Project: Digital Banking Transformation program focused on Payments, Transaction Banking, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, CASA, Deposits, Cards, Retail & Corporate Lending, Account Servicing, KYC/AML Compliance, and Core Banking (Finacle) integration across Net Banking and Mobile Banking channels. Roles & Responsibilities:

Led requirement gathering and implementation for Digital Banking, Payments, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, CASA, Deposits, Cards, Lending, and Account Servicing initiatives across Net Banking and Mobile Banking platforms.

Supported Cross-Border Payments, SWIFT MT, and ISO 20022 readiness initiatives as part of payment modernization programs.

Worked on Payments and Transaction Banking journeys including fund transfers, beneficiary management, payment processing, digital channels, and customer servicing workflows.

Gathered and documented business requirements for Retail Lending and Corporate Lending products across Loan Origination System (LOS).

Supported loan onboarding, credit assessment, loan processing, sanction, disbursement, servicing, and collections journeys.

Collaborated with Business, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams to deliver process transformation and digital banking initiatives.

Conducted Gap Analysis (AS-IS / TO-BE), process optimization, and automation initiatives across payments, lending, and account servicing functions.

Prepared BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Flows, Acceptance Criteria, and Functional Specifications. • Supported integrations with Core Banking (Finacle), Payments, KYC/AML, CRM, and third-party systems. • Coordinated UAT, defect management, business validation, and production deployments to ensure successful implementation.

Previous Work Experience:

Deputy Branch Manager, Retail Banking at IndusInd Bank during Sep-18 & Mar-19 at Nagpur. • Deputy Branch Manager, Retail Banking at ICICI Bank during May-16 & Aug-18 at Nagpur. • Assistant Branch Manager, Retail Banking at HDFC Bank during July-15 & May-16 at Nagpur. • Worked as Branch Manager in ESAF Microfinance Pvt Ltd During Dec 2014 - May 2015. • Worked as Officer at Global Education Consultancy Service during Aug 2012 – Mar 2013. • Worked in Risk Management Operations at BSFL during July 2010 – July 2012. • Worked as Team Coordinator in Malati Ashraya NGO during May 2007 – May 2009. Agile Scrum Model, Waterfall Model, Business Process flow diagrams, Jira tool, MS Visio, Balsamiq, Confluence.

Deputy Branch Manager, Retail Banking at IndusInd Bank during Sep-18 & Mar-19 at Nagpur. • Deputy Branch Manager, Retail Banking at ICICI Bank during May-16 & Aug-18 at Nagpur. • Assistant Branch Manager, Retail Banking at HDFC Bank during July-15 & May-16 at Nagpur. • Worked as Branch Manager in ESAF Microfinance Pvt Ltd During Dec 2014 - May 2015. • Worked as Officer at Global Education Consultancy Service during Aug 2012 – Mar 2013. • Worked in Risk Management Operations at BSFL during July 2010 – July 2012. • Worked as Team Coordinator in Malati Ashraya NGO during May 2007 – May 2009. Agile Scrum Model, Waterfall Model, Business Process flow diagrams, Jira tool, MS Visio, Balsamiq, Confluence.

Technical Skills:

Office Tools

MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint.

Education & Certifications:

Certified ScrumMaster® (CSM) — Scrum Alliance • PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) • • Bachelor of Science from Burdwan University, West Bengal in 2008. Jira User Certification

KEY ACHIEVEMENT

Led multiple Agile Scrum teams across Banking and Financial Services transformation programs. • Improved delivery predictability using Agile metrics and continuous improvement initiatives. • Enabled successful Agile transformation from Waterfall delivery models. • Delivered large-scale Retail Lending and Core Banking modernization initiatives. • Established governance and reporting mechanisms that enhanced stakeholder confidence and delivery transparency.

Personal Details: Date of Birth: Languages Known: Strengths:

14th May 1987. English, Hindi & Marathi. Analytical, adaptable, quick learner, strong communicator, stakeholder-focused, detail- oriented, and collaborative team player.

Professional Experience 1) MITS Global Consulting Pvt Ltd Client: CSB Bank, Mumbai Duration: June 2024 to June 2026.
Senior Business Analyst – Digital Banking, Payments & Corporate Lending Project: Digital Banking Transformation covering Customer Onboarding, Payments, CASA, Deposits, Corporate Lending, Account Servicing, KYC/AML Compliance, and Core Banking (Flexcube) integration across Net Banking and Mobile Banking platforms.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Gathered, analyzed, and documented business requirements through BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, and Process Flows.
Led requirement analysis and solution design for Payments, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, CASA, Deposits, Account Servicing, and Corporate Lending journeys.
Worked on Domestic Payments (UPI, NEFT, RTGS, IMPS), payment processing, reconciliation, transaction lifecycle management, and customer servicing workflows.
Supported Cross-Border Payments, SWIFT MT, and ISO 20022 readiness initiatives as part of payment modernization programs.
Conducted AS-IS / TO-BE analysis, Gap Analysis, process optimization, and digital transformation initiatives. • Collaborated with Business, Operations, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Product, and Technology teams to deliver banking and payments solutions.
Supported Corporate Lending processes including customer onboarding, credit assessment, loan origination, disbursement, servicing, and collections journeys.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops, backlog refinement, requirement walkthroughs, and business sign-offs in Agile delivery environments.
Supported UAT planning, test case reviews, defect management, release validation, and production readiness activities.
Coordinated integrations across Flexcube, Payments, KYC/AML, CRM, APIs, and third-party banking systems.
2) Aarav Global Products & Services Pvt Ltd. Client: Bank of Baroda - Feb 2024 to June 2024.
Business Analyst – Cards & Payments | Credit Card Origination & Servicing
Roles & Responsibilities:
• Gathered and documented requirements for Co-Branded Credit Card Origination, Servicing, and Card Lifecycle
Management initiatives.
Prepared BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Flows, and API Integration documentation. • Collaborated with Business Teams, IT Vendors, and Technology teams to deliver Cards & Payments solutions. • Conducted Gap Analysis (AS-IS / TO-BE) and defined business requirements, scope, and acceptance criteria. • Facilitated requirement walkthroughs and coordinated with UI/UX, Development, and QA teams. • Supported UAT, test case reviews, defect resolution, and business sign-off activities. • Managed stakeholder communication and vendor coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
3) Axis Bank Ltd Duration: Apr 2019 to Feb 2024. Business Analyst – Digital Banking, Payments, Retail Banking & Corporate Lending Transformation Project: Digital Banking Transformation program focused on Payments, Transaction Banking, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, CASA, Deposits, Cards, Retail & Corporate Lending, Account Servicing, KYC/AML Compliance, and Core Banking (Finacle) integration across Net Banking and Mobile Banking channels. Roles & Responsibilities:
Led requirement gathering and implementation for Digital Banking, Payments, Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, CASA, Deposits, Cards, Lending, and Account Servicing initiatives across Net Banking and Mobile Banking platforms.
Supported Cross-Border Payments, SWIFT MT, and ISO 20022 readiness initiatives as part of payment modernization programs.
Worked on Payments and Transaction Banking journeys including fund transfers, beneficiary management, payment processing, digital channels, and customer servicing workflows.
Gathered and documented business requirements for Retail Lending and Corporate Lending products across Loan Origination System (LOS).
Supported loan onboarding, credit assessment, loan processing, sanction, disbursement, servicing, and collections journeys.
Collaborated with Business, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams to deliver process transformation and digital banking initiatives.
Conducted Gap Analysis (AS-IS / TO-BE), process optimization, and automation initiatives across payments, lending, and account servicing functions.
Prepared BRDs, FRDs, User Stories, Process Flows, Acceptance Criteria, and Functional Specifications. • Supported integrations with Core Banking (Finacle), Payments, KYC/AML, CRM, and third-party systems. • Coordinated UAT, defect management, business validation, and production deployments to ensure successful implementation.
